title: Simon Kohl Named to Observer’s 2025 A.I. Power Index - Latent Labs
content: 18.09.25 Simon Kohl Named to Observer’s 2025 A.I. Power Index Share: Share Recognition highlights leaders driving artificial intelligence innovation across industries New York, September 17, 2025 — Simon Kohl, Founder & CEO at Latent Labs, has been selected for Observer's 2025 A.I. Power Index, recognizing the most influential leaders and innovators advancing artificial intelligence globally. Observer Power Lists represent the industry's most prestigious recognition across multiple sectors. The A.I. Power Index specifically honors executives and visionaries making measurable impact in artificial intelligence—leaders converting data into market influence, revenue growth and transformational change. "I saw we were at an inflection point where generative A.I. could make biology truly programmable. We're not just understanding nature anymore, we're becoming capable of authoring it with precision." said Kohl. " Recognition on Observer's 2025 A.I. Power Index reflects our commitment to pioneering artificial intelligence solutions that drive real-world impact." View the complete 2025 A.I.
